en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

People tend to get sleepy when they
watch a boring movie.

When I play the piano, two hours pass
by so quickly. It's interesting how time flies.

I'm glad you were thinking the same
thing, though.

It would be pretty embarrassing if I had
been the only one to fall asleep...
Sorry, but I don't think so.

So many people worked hard on every
one of those movies.
I don't like the way you're acting...

Huh? What's up?
Are you saying you don't like movies?
Then, why did we come here?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
